podcast.title: Breakthrough with "Popstar" Music Video
podcast.body: Fella, Director X's production company, achieved a significant breakthrough with the music video for "Popstar," featuring DJ Khaled, Drake, and Justin Bieber. "We broke our production company, Fella, with this music video for DJ Khaled Drake and Bieber called Popstar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Music Video Production Company
podcast.body: Fella is a production company co-founded by Director X and Taj Khrishlow, which gained prominence through its work on music videos, notably "Topstar" for DJ Khaled, Drake, and Justin Bieber. "We broke our production company, Fella, with this music video for DJ Khaled, Drake and Bieber called Topstar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
